items.title: createShippingOptionTypesStep
items.description: This step creates one or more shipping option types.

items.title: deleteShippingOptionTypesStep
items.description: This step deletes one or more shipping option types.

items.title: listShippingOptionsForContextStep
items.description:
This step retrieves shipping options that can be used in the specified context, based on
the shipping options' rules.

items.title: updateShippingOptionTypesStep
items.description: This step updates shipping option types matching the specified filters.
